response.overview: "There Was a War Somewhere" – Documentary, 35mm.  B&W, 2 reels (20 min). "Mematiane" Studio for Popular-Science and Documentary Films – 1989.  Screenwriter and Director: Vazha Zubashvili.  Cinematographers: Leri Mikhanashvili, Niko Ajibegishvili.  Editor: Ira Nikoladze.  Sound Engineer: Liudmila Rukhadze.  Film Director: Jambul Gogoladze.  Narrator: Vazha Zubashvili.  Featuring: Combatant Temur Liparteliani and others (Kako Gorgadze, Nugzar Mikhanashvili, Jemal Khitarishvili, and members of the Tbilisi Patriotic Education Club).  The film explores the failure of Soviet ideology and the grim consequences of fulfilling the Soviet "internationalist duty" in Afghanistan, set against a backdrop of revanchist propaganda.  The film participated in the competition at the All-Union Documentary Film Festival in Voronezh in 1989.
